purpose: Synthetic-only test of passing FFmpeg MOV CENC decryption_key through the concat demuxer without placing key material in FFmpeg argv
method: Generated a three-second 440 Hz, 44100 Hz mono FLAC-in-MP4 reference and ordinary plus fragmented CENC AES-CTR MP4 samples with synthetic key and KID. Wrote an ffconcat manifest with absolute media path, `option decryption_key <synthetic hex>`, and `duration 3` to a temporary 0600 file. Passed only the manifest path in argv, then decoded all audio to s16le and compared bytes against the clear reference. Also applied output-side `-ss 1` after the input and compared against the same seek from the clear reference.

key_transport.stdin_manifest_attempt: Failed for absolute media paths in this invocation: concat resolved `/tmp/.../file.mp4` relative to `pipe:0` as `pipe:/tmp/.../file.mp4`. The 0600 temporary-file manifest worked.

implementation_implication: A native launcher can create a private, mode-0600 ffconcat manifest, invoke FFmpeg with only the manifest path, and unlink it after process completion. This is simpler than a libavformat helper and worked for full decode and post-input start seek in both synthetic container forms. Key material remains briefly on disk in the manifest; cleanup and restrictive permissions are part of this method. This probe does not validate provider URLs, live credentials, real media, or device playback.

official_reference.title: FFmpeg Formats Documentation, concat demuxer syntax
official_reference.note: Documents per-file `option key value` directives and `duration` directives in an ffconcat script.
